+def _ensure_class_node_attrs(node: nodes.ClassDef) -> nodes.ClassDef:
+    """Initialize the legacy analysis attributes on a class node.
+
+    Before the dataclass wrapper refactor, analysis data (locals_type,
+    compositions_type, ...) was stored directly on the astroid nodes. This
+    helper makes those attributes available again so code using the legacy API
+    (e.g. calling relationship handlers without an explicit ``ClassInfo``)
+    keeps working.
+    """
+    for attr in (
+        "locals_type",
+        "instance_attrs_type",
+        "compositions_type",
+        "aggregations_type",
+        "associations_type",
+    ):
+        if not hasattr(node, attr):
+            setattr(node, attr, collections.defaultdict(list))
+    return node
+
